articles.title: Discord is making public chats searchable on Google: How to opt out
articles.snippet: Discord conversations on large public servers will soon reach audiences far beyond their communities, raising privacy concerns.

articles.title: Coinbase Customer Data Hit in Analytics Vendor Breach, Funds ‘Not Impacted’
articles.snippet: The incident at analytics firm Amplitude hit a "small subset" of Coinbase customers, the exchange said, without saying how many.

articles.title: China's Stock Market Has Lost $2.4 Trillion as Investors Doubt Its AI Boom Will Ever Pay Off
articles.snippet: Stocks on China's mainland have shed about $2.4 trillion since May as investors doubt AI companies can turn a profit, while U.S. restrictions and high U.S. interest rates add pressure.
